name: Single Item Cart for WooCommerce
author: Asad Ali

sections.description:
Single Item Cart for WooCommerce is designed for stores that sell one product at a time, such as single-product checkout funnels, bookings represented by WooCommerce products, or focused campaign stores.

When a shopper adds a product, the plugin removes other cart lines and keeps the newly added line. The selected product can still have a quantity greater than one. Product variations and item metadata stay with the selected line. Existing carts with multiple lines are reduced to the last line when loaded.

The plugin works with classic WooCommerce carts and the WooCommerce Store API used by Cart and Checkout blocks. It has no settings, external service, tracking, or database table.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate Single Item Cart for WooCommerce.
  3. Add products to the cart to confirm that the most recently added product replaces the previous product line.
sections.faq:
Does this limit quantity to one?

No. It limits the cart to one product line. The shopper can buy multiple units of that product if WooCommerce and the product permit it.

Does this work with variable products?

Yes. The newly added variation is kept as the one cart line.

Will it contact ZTABS or store customer information?

No. It processes the cart within WooCommerce and does not send data to ZTABS.

short_description: Keep one product line in a WooCommerce cart. Adding a different product replaces the previous cart item while preserving the new item's quantity.
